summary: Russia launched a major aerial attack overnight involving hundreds of UAVs and missile strikes on logistics, port, and military infrastructure across multiple Ukrainian regions. A Russian drone struck the SBU headquarters in central Kyiv, with President Zelensky confirming five wounded and stating Ukraine is preparing a response. On the ground, Russian forces claimed advances in Donetsk, Kharkov, Kupyansk, and Zaporizhzhia directions while Ukrainian drone strikes continued targeting Russian airspace.
key_points: President Zelensky confirmed a Russian drone struck the SBU building in central Kyiv, targeting the head of SBU's office directly; five people were wounded and Ukraine is preparing a response. (Source: @UkraineNow/83888)

Russian Ministry of Defense reported overnight strikes on the Biocon logistics center in Kyiv region, a Nova Poshta facility near Odessa, and a depot in Dnepropetrovsk, with one injured in Kropyvnytsky. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)
Russia's MOD claimed liberation of Gruzskoye northeast of Dobropolye, Vasilevka/Blagodatnoye/Dolzhanka in Kharkov direction, and Izhevka in the Druzhkovka direction. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32998)

Ukraine adopted new air-raid rules dividing alerts into yellow (drone) and red (missile/combined) levels, allowing business to operate under yellow with shelter access and recommending curfew adjustment from 01:00–05:00. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23797)

Ukraine faces critical Patriot missile shortage with Greece, Spain, Japan, and South Korea unwilling to transfer interceptors while global stockpiles dwindle amid Middle East tensions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33011)

Ukrainian intelligence chief Budanov stated peace talks may resume by late September but ceasefire conditions unlikely before spring 2027, predicting Russia will attempt a fourth winter bombing campaign. (Source: @UkraineNow/83886)

Ukraine plans to scale up UAV operations near Russian airports to paralyze civilian air traffic in European Russia, shifting from isolated alerts to sustained disruption. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33005)
Russia sent an urgent appeal to ICAO Secretary General regarding Ukrainian threats to civil aviation after Moscow rejected Kyiv's NOTAM warnings about Russian airspace. (Source: @tass_agency/393813)

sections.executive_summary: Russia executed a massive overnight combined aerial assault involving over 460 downed UAVs across 12 Russian regions and continued strikes on Ukrainian logistics and port infrastructure. A Russian drone directly struck the SBU headquarters in central Kyiv, which Zelensky described as targeting the SBU chief's office, with five wounded and a Ukrainian response being prepared. Ground combat intensified across multiple axes with Russian forces claiming advances in Donetsk, Kharkov, Kupyansk, and Zaporizhzhia directions.

points: Ukraine adopted a two-tier air-raid alert system with yellow level for drone threats allowing business continuity under strict shelter requirements, and red level for missile/combined strikes requiring mandatory shelter use and work suspension. The government gave businesses three months to ensure shelter access and recommended Kyiv adjust curfew to 01:00–05:00. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23797)

Ukraine faces serious Patriot missile shortages with Greece, Spain, Japan, and South Korea refusing to transfer interceptors; global stockpiles are dwindling due to Iran conflict demands. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33011)
Finance Minister Marchenko stated Ukraine faces a $32.6 billion budget shortfall by 2027, highlighting severe fiscal pressure amid continued conflict. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33010)

President Zelensky confirmed a Russian drone struck the SBU building in central Kyiv, saying the drone was aimed directly at the office of SBU head Oleksandr Poklad; five people were wounded and Ukraine is preparing a response. (Source: @UkraineNow/83888)

Ukraine launched a warehouse decentralization program to protect businesses from systematic Russian strikes, with working groups helping entrepreneurs relocate storage to safer communities and establish backup logistics sites. (Source: @UkraineNow/83869)

Hungarian PM Magyar confirmed Hungary will continue providing protection to Ukrainian draft-age men despite new EU rules limiting temporary protection for those who have not fulfilled military obligations in Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/83889)

Russia's MOD claimed its forces struck a logistics center in Brovary storing dual-use goods and military property, with the Ukrainian side calling the targeted Biocon facility in Velikaya Aleksandrovka a pharmaceutical warehouse. (Source: @tass_agency/393779, @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

Russian air defenses reported destruction of 426 Ukrainian UAVs over 12 regions, Moscow region, and Crimea during daytime hours, plus 35 additional drones overnight with Mayor reporting Moscow interceptions. Fires broke out at an oil depot in Sochi and the Sirius Federal Territory, damaging residential building windows. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

Russia sent an urgent appeal to ICAO Secretary General over Ukrainian threats to civil aviation and categorically rejected Ukrainian NOTAM warnings claiming Russian airspace is unsafe. (Source: @tass_agency/393813)

Belgorod region suffered heavy casualties from Ukrainian drone strikes: an FPV drone killed one passenger and wounded a bus driver in Shebekino morning attack, a second drone wounded three men in a truck, and an evening attack killed four including a doctor, paramedic, and married couple with three more wounded. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

In the DPR, three civilians were killed and 14 wounded by attack UAVs in 24 hours, with strikes hitting Volnovakha municipal transport, a Gorlovka passenger bus, and a Krasny Partizan garbage truck, damaging six houses, three infrastructure facilities, and over 20 vehicles. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

Russia's MOD reported up to 55 Ukrainian losses in the Dnipro Group of Forces area of responsibility following strikes on Ukrainian positions near Novodmitrovka and Kherson. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

In Sumy direction, Russian forces continued offensive operations with enemy confirming advance near Ryasny while a storm attempt in the Pasek forest was called unsuccessful; Russian MOD reported strikes on Ukrainian units near Kiyanitsa, Ulanovo, and Khoteni. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

Russia claimed liberation of Gruzskoye northeast of Dobropolye, with Ukrainian sources reporting Russian advance north of Krasnoyarsk in the broader Pokrovsk direction where Ukrainian General Staff recorded 26 attacks in 24 hours — the highest intensity among all axes. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32998, @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

In the Krasnolimansky and Slavyansky directions, Ukrainian General Staff counted seven Russian attacks by 22:00 with Russian units penetrating into Nikolayevka just south of Slavyansk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

Russia's MOD claimed liberation of Izhevka in the Druzhkovka direction; the enemy confirms Russian flags appearing in the village but considers most of it a gray zone without full control. Ukrainian sources report Russian advance south of Chervonoye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)
On the Zaporozhye front, reports indicate Russian advances north of Lugovskoye and east of Gulyaipole. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

Kharkov direction saw Russian MOD claim taking of Vasilevka, Blagodatnoye, and Dolzhanka, while Ukrainian sources report Russian advances near Bochkove in Volchansk direction and near Ivashino in Velikoburluk direction. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

Fighting continues for Kazachya Lopan with the Ukrainian side disputing Russian control claims, but the Dergachi administration acknowledges the presence of Russian units in the village's northern part. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)
A reactive UAV was tracked heading toward Chernihiv region, passing Slavutych on a southerly course according to air defense monitoring. (Source: @kpszsu/76428)
Tactical aviation activity was detected in the northeastern and eastern directions, with KAB glide bomb launches targeting Sumy region and threats to frontline oblasts. (Source: @kpszsu/76422)

In Kupyansk direction, Ukrainian sources confirmed Russian group operations west of the Oskol River in central Kupyansk and near Moskovka, with fighting near Kovsharovka and Kurilovka; Russian units reportedly took positions in a multi-story building in Kovsharovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

Russia's MOD reported a strike on a Nova Poshta logistics center near Odessa along with two dry cargo ships and port infrastructure; a separate strike hit a depot and Nova Poshta branch in Dnepropetrovsk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

In Kherson direction, Russian strikes targeted Ukrainian units near Novodmitrovka and Kherson with claimed up to 55 enemy losses in the Dnieper Group's area of responsibility. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

Hostile UAVs from the Black Sea were tracked heading toward Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi, while reactive UAVs moved along the Odesa-Mykolaiv oblast border on a northwesterly course. (Source: @kpszsu/76390, @kpszsu/76430)

A massive air alert was declared across Kyiv at 19:21 with air raid lifted at 20:13; monitoring indicated reactive Shaheds circling over Vasylkiv and reconnaissance drones over Kyiv and Kyiv region. (Source: @eRadarrua/110775, @eRadarrua/110805, @mon1tor_ua/73698)
Air tracking detected guided drones on Zhytomyr region heading to Ruzhyn and guided drones on Kyiv region targeting Obukhiv and Vasylkiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/110785)
Monitoring indicated no massive combined strike overnight, though ballistic missile threat to Kyiv remained at a stable medium-to-high level. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73710)
A reactive Shahed reportedly fell on the Respublika shopping mall and Nova Poshta Terminal area, indicating drone penetration into dense urban areas. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73673)

Ukraine plans to increase UAV operations near Russian airports to paralyze civilian air traffic in European Russia, moving from isolated alerts to sustained disruption according to the Ukrainian Volunteer Army. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33005)

Ukrainian drone strikes hit Belgorod region causing multiple casualties including a doctor and paramedic killed in Shebekino, plus DPR casualties of 3 killed and 14 wounded in 24 hours. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32991)

Russia sent urgent appeal to ICAO over Ukrainian civil aviation threats while Ukraine plans scaled-up UAV operations near Russian airports to paralyze European Russia civilian air traffic. (Source: @tass_agency/393813, @ukr_leaks_eng/33005)

sections.threat_assessment: The operational tempo has sharply escalated with Russia executing coordinated UAV and missile strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions while conducting ground advances along at least five axes. The direct Russian drone strike on the SBU headquarters in central Kyiv represents a significant escalation in targeting Ukrainian security service leadership and will likely provoke a Ukrainian retaliatory strike on Russian government infrastructure. The simultaneous Ukrainian expansion of long-range drone operations against Russian airports signals a widening of the conflict's strategic reach into European Russia.
sections.regional_response: Russia escalated diplomatic activity by urgently appealing to ICAO over Ukrainian threats to civil aviation and rejecting Kyiv's NOTAM airspace warnings, framing the dispute as an international aviation safety issue. Hungary declared it will continue protecting Ukrainian draft-age men despite new EU restrictions on temporary protection, creating a direct challenge to EU consensus on Ukraine-related policies. Ukraine's pivot to a two-tier alert system and warehouse decentralization program reflects governmental adaptation to sustained aerial bombardment and infrastructure vulnerability.
sections.intelligence_notes: The pattern of Russian strikes specifically targeting logistics hubs (Biocon, Nova Poshta, dry cargo ships, oil depots) indicates an effort to degrade Ukraine's sustainment capacity and economic infrastructure rather than purely military targets. Ukrainian deployment of drones near Russian airports represents an evolution from tactical drone use to strategic airspace denial operations that may force Russia to allocate substantial air defense resources to civilian aviation protection. The reported 426 Ukrainian UAVs downed over 12 Russian regions in a single day suggests an unprecedented scale of Ukrainian drone production and sortie generation.
